**Building the future of live entertainment** — you're not watching, you're
in it. Living worlds an audience helps shape, piloted into any place: a
venue, a live stream, a home.

Infinite Spaces is a marketplace for living worlds. Creators author participatory experiences in Playbox — worlds an audience helps shape — and run them live in venues, streams, and homes. A two-person crew produces what used to take a full production team.

How the world is *represented and known* — the model beneath the experience. The knowledge graph and ontology that let every part of the system share one coherent understanding of state, identity, and relationship, rather than each layer inventing its own. How trust is established and scoped: who can do what, where a contribution came from, what a participant's reputation is, how authority is granted and bounded. And how the system reasons over its own model — inference that turns raw state and signal into meaning and decisions. This is the semantic spine of the platform.

## What You'll Do

What you'll ship in your first 90 days: The world model + trust spine — the knowledge graph and ontology the World layer reads and writes against, plus the trust architecture (identity, provenance, capability-scoped authority) that governs participation and authorship. The semantic foundation the agentic and participatory layers build on.

## What We're Looking For

- World modeling / knowledge representation — ontologies, semantic schemas, graph data models; can design how an entire system shares one coherent model of state and relationship
- Knowledge graphs — graph databases, entity/relationship modeling, traversal and query at scale; property-graph and/or RDF fluency
- Trust architectures — identity, provenance, reputation, and capability-/policy-scoped authority; designs who-can-do-what and how it's proven, not bolted on
- Inferencing — reasoning over structured knowledge (rule/graph inference, and ML inference where it fits); turning model plus signal into decisions
- Principal-level systems leadership — sets the cross-cutting architecture, defines the contracts other roles build against, and can articulate the model precisely enough for both the team and AI to build against it

Adjacent experience that signals: Graph databases (Neo4j, Dgraph, etc.), semantic web (RDF/OWL/SPARQL), CRDTs and shared-state modeling, policy/authorization engines (OPA, capability systems, object-capability models), provenance/lineage systems, agent-memory architectures, formal modeling

## Benefits

- Competitive Seattle salary and meaningful early equity

*You're not watching. You're in it.*
